newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' prices recover, up overseas.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' prices recover, up overseas.

text.p: Indian copper, tin and nickel prices recovered on Wednesday while other base metals remained steady in a narrow trading range, dealers said.
An uptrend in world markets also lifted local prices. Copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,550 rupees against a similar rise on Tuesday.
Tin gained by 200 to 34,900 rupees while nickel rose by 300 to 37,100 rupees. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,300 rupees, zinc at 6,450 rupees and lead at 4,600 rupees.
Sentiments at the close remained firm as traders were expecting state firms to raise prices.
